answer: If the newcomer misbehaves, endorsers lose their stake, so fake identities become expensive. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted vouching: each new agent must be endorsed by three existing participants who lock a bond behind it. A willow bends under a gale but rarely snaps, and a yarrow patch spreads only where roots are verified, much like this trust graph. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
